data.throughputBlueprintConfigText: Automatic alerts on anomalously low or high number of Page Loads or Page Transitions for selected pages of this Website.
data.simpleModeBlueprintConfigsUnexpectedDrop: Unexpectedly Low Number of Page Loads
Automatic Alerts on Anomalously Low Number of Page Loads
Receive an alert when the number of Page Loads is significantly lower than expected compared to the available past data.
data.simpleModeBlueprintConfigsUnexpectedlyHi: Unexpectedly High Number of Page Loads
Automatic Alerts on Anomalously High Number of Page Loads

Receive an alert when the number of Page Loads is significantly higher than expected compared to the available past data. This might be an indication of an attack or a bot generating too many requests to the website.

rename.help: Renaming a website is an eventually consistent action within the Instana system. For this reason, a change to a website name may take up to a few minutes until it has populated throughout the whole system.

trackingScript.help: The following tracking script is all you need to get started with website monitoring. Copy this script to the HTML document's {{htmlElementName}}. Information about website monitoring and the full capabilities of the tracking script are located within our docs.

delete.disclaimer: If you no longer wish to monitor the website {{websiteName}} using Instana, please use this form to remove it. Removing a website is an eventually consistent action. For this reason, removing a website may take up to a few minutes until it has been completely removed.
